boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 123 wraps a perimeter frame around a central purple tube, with hammer-tool obstacles guarding the numbered pocket counters. The perimeter tiles must drain before the tube accepts input — and the green `3` tile highlighted with a yellow line is the gating piece. Clear the top-left pink pocket first, then work the hammer tools inward to open the tube.
landmarks: Block Out Level 123 wraps a perimeter frame around a central purple tube, with hammer-tool obstacles guarding the numbered pocket counters.
The perimeter tiles must drain before the tube accepts input — and the green `3` tile highlighted with a yellow line is the gating piece.
Clear the top-left pink pocket first, then work the hammer tools inward to open the tube.

quickTips: Break the orange hammer-tool pair before feeding any blue tile into the central tube.
Keep the bottom pink row parked until the top perimeter is fully thin.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Peel the top-left pink `4` cluster and the green `5` tile without touching the central orange `3`.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Break the twin orange hammer-tool blocks on the top-right before feeding any right-wall blue tiles.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Drain the left-wall blue `5` column and the white `1` corner tile to open the left tube entrance.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the bottom pink row and the green/orange bottom pair once the top perimeter is thin.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Route the green `3` tile through the central purple tube using the yellow vertical lane marker.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish the right-wall blue `4`/`2` pair and the remaining blue scraps for the PERFECT clear.

failurePoints: Feeding blue tiles into the tube before the hammer-tool blocks break — this pins the green `3` inside.
Clearing the bottom pink row before the top perimeter thins, sealing the tube corridor.
